note: [LLM critic, low conf] The AI sends 3 Allarus models (18 wounds) at a 2-wound lone model. This wastes most of the unit's melee output. The 97% chance and the ch_short_charge bonus push the score above the higher-value Blade Champion Alpha. Fix: Cap the damage credit at the target's remaining wounds, and scale ch_short_charge by the target's points value. Add an overkill penalty when the unit's expected damage far exceeds the target's wounds. Where the unit can pick several targets after the roll, favour the plan that includes the most valuable target.
